rationale: The replay-completion account records the boundary pair (2048 delivered tuples returning, 2049 blocking) and the default-configuration pair (a committed range of 12001 entries above an absent snapshot with the flag-on restart blocking and the flag-off control returning) from single executions each. Both were run by the same fixed experiment 3b4f2310a3bf43a492eea0cfedd79dd0-experiment, whose harness contains the replay, bound, boundary and default-configuration cases, so one repeat of it re-observes all of them from the retained inputs in a clean copy. The reproduction question is whether the two pairs come back with the same operands and the same split between a blocked replay-enabled restart and a returning flag-off control, which is what the account's schedule-variation limitation currently cannot answer.
